title: The Moth in the Bath
lines: Mom runs a bath in the big tub.
Josh gets in with his red duck.
Then a moth falls in with him!
Josh taps the tub, but the moth sits.
He sets a thin red mug in the bath.
The moth gets on the mug and sits.
Josh sets the mug up on the path.
The moth sits. Then it is up and off.
"That moth had a bath as well!" said Mom.

questions.ask: Josh taps the tub first. Does that get the moth out?
questions.listenFor: No - the moth just sits. Line five says it. That is his first try, and it does not work.

questions.ask: What does Josh use to get the moth out?
questions.listenFor: A thin red mug. Line six says it - have them reread that line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: What did Josh try first to get the moth out? What did he do after that?
questions.listenFor: He tapped the tub, then set a thin red mug in the bath. Lines five and six, in that order.
